name: Spuskaemiy apparat Veneri-4
about: Spuskaemiy apparat Veneri-4 (1967-058, MOM), launched 1967 Jun 12. Its phases from GCAT: HCO, Venus. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Venus on GCAT's date); its perihelion 0.716 au and aphelion 1.019 au against GCAT's 0.710 and 1.020
